_comment: Shared AgentPay config — copy to 'agentpay.config.json' (gitignored) and fill in. Read by the SDK, the MCP server AND the HTTP server with identical precedence: AGENTPAY_* env var > this file > defaults.json (templates) > built-in default. Put the file in the working directory, or at the OS user-config dir (%APPDATA%\agentpay\ on Windows, ~/Library/Application Support/agentpay/ on macOS, ~/.config/agentpay/ on Linux), or point AGENTPAY_CONFIG at any path. Every key is optional; omit what a given surface does not need. Keys map 1:1 to AGENTPAY_* env names (prefix dropped, lowercased).
